author: Yieldscope
description:
Stablecoin flexible yield rates, with venue safety grades
	

A daily record of what centralised crypto venues actually pay on stablecoins,
collected by YieldScope and published with the safety
grade of the venue paying each rate.
The grade is the part you will not find in other rate datasets, and it is the
reason this one is worth joining against.

	
		
	
	
		What is in it
	


	
		




		
Rows
1,661


Venue-asset pairs
50


Venues
20


Assets
DAI, FDUSD, PYUSD, TUSD, USD1, USDC… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Yieldscope/stablecoin-yield-rates-with-safety-grades.
